note: Missing `accessToken` — the Management Client's token is the evidence of the person's authority.
`ruleId` in the request — the provider sets the rule's identifier (HCP 6.3, 9.4.14); it is never taken from the request.
`effect` in the request — the provider sets it to `deny` (HCP 9.4.14).
Neither `operators` nor `requires` — HCP requires one of them, or both (HCP 6.3, 9.4.14); a rule with neither would deny every operator.
Empty `operators` — absent means every operator; an empty array names none (minItems 1).
A `requires` claim that is not an absolute URI — client conformance claims are URIs (HCP 18.1).
A category that is neither a registry slug nor an absolute URI (HCP 4.5).
Missing `rule` — HCP answers 201 with the rule (HCP 9.4.14).
A rule whose `effect` is not `deny` — the only effect in HCP 2.0-draft-3 (HCP 6.3).
